## Use Azeret Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Azeret Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Azeret Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Azeret Mono coding font

A contemporary geometric monospace with a broad weight range. Azeret Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Azeret Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Azeret Mono FAQ

### Is Azeret Mono free?

Yes. Azeret Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Azeret Mono support ligatures?

No. Azeret Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Azeret Mono?

Azeret Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
